text:
rachel: Deploybot alarmed on canary error-rate jump in us-east-1, auto-rollback started. Can anyone peek?
deploybot: [AUTOMATED] 2024-10-03 14:12:08 UTC: CANARY_ERROR_RATE > THRESHOLD (5xx_rate=3.2%, threshold=1.0%). Auto-rollback: candidate tag v4.0.1 -> stable v4.0.0. Rolling back canary 15% -> 0% over 3m.
dev_oncall: I'm seeing rapid 5xx traces, stack shows kv-cache misses + OOM on infer-edge-3. Might be memory regression from the LLM-compile patch.
platform_eng: Note: dedicated and reserved pools are pinned and opt-out of auto-rollback. This affects hosted canary traffic only.
cs_lead: CS: 2 customers filed slow/failed requests. Will prepare a short status note if rollback doesn't finish quickly.
ops_bot: If rollback completes, we'll need release_notes_unwind and rollback-postmortem steps.
dev_oncall: Two options: 1) let rollout finish (safe, immediate), 2) pause rollout, cherry-pick a small revert for the compile flag and re-run canary (lower user impact overall).
rachel: Quick risk check: does aborting rollback risk half-finished state where some nodes are on v4.0.1 and others on v4.0.0? What's the atomicity of the rollback runner?
platform_eng: rollback-runner is slice-based; aborting will stop the reversion mid-slice but leaves traffic split as-is. We can pause the deployment which keeps current canary traffic steady.
dev_oncall: Commands: 
```
deploybot pause --tag v4.0.1 --deployment canary --reason "investigating 5xxs"
rollback-runner abort --thread 1729990000
```
cs_lead: Prefer pause and hotfix if it's a single flag. Minimizes churn for end users.
ops_bot: Reminder: auto-rollback suppression will block further auto actions for 45m unless overridden.
rachel: I'm going to pause automated rollback and start the cherrypick. Can someone create cherrypick PR and mark it hotfix-v4.0.1-revert?
platform_eng: Creating PR now -> #4456. Patch: revert compile-optimizations flag for runtime. Release note blurb: "fix(runtime): revert compile optimization that increases memory pressure under certain seq lengths".
dev_oncall: Rolling patch to 1 canary node now. Monitoring OOMs and 5xx rate.
platform_eng: After patch: infer-edge-3 OOMs stopped, 5xx fell from 3.2% -> 0.6% within 4 mins. KV-cache miss rate dropped too.
cs_lead: Sending update to customers: "We paused automatic rollout and applied a hotfix; issue mitigated. We will follow up with a full postmortem and timeline." Draft attached.
ops_bot: Since we aborted the automatic rollback and applied hotfix, set incident_status=mitigated_hotfix. No release_notes_unwind necessary.
rachel: Good. Keep canary pinned for 20m of clean telemetry then finish the rollout. Dev_oncall, please owner the postmortem for root cause.
dev_oncall: Will do. I'll collect traces and memory profiles.
platform_eng: PR merged and release registry updated to v4.0.1-hotfix.
cs_lead: Customer notes sent. Adding follow-up note: "If you observed failures between 14:10-14:15 UTC please share request IDs."
rachel: Closing thread after clean 20m hold and final promotion. Thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
